items.name: Food worker cards for staff
items.quote: All food workers are required, per Chapter 246-217 WAC , to have a valid food worker card to work in Washington.

items.name: Seattle business license tax certificate
items.quote: Anyone doing business in Seattle must have a Seattle business license tax certificate, also known as a business license or general business license.

items.name: Food establishment plan review
items.agency: Public Health, Seattle and King County
items.quote: Food business owners must submit plans for review before construction, remodeling, or changing ownership takes place.

items.name: Construction permit for the tenant improvement
items.agency: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections
items.quote: Final Inspections Once all permits have been approved and construction has been completed, final inspections need to be scheduled.

items.name: Food business permit
items.agency: Public Health, Seattle and King County
items.quote: A successful plan review approval and pre-operational inspection are required prior to starting operations.
